name: mashuprpg4 forest palette
source: Sampled from ref_imgs/act1_daytime and ref_imgs/act1_foggy (k-means over ~1.5M pixels per state plus small-region averages), then hand-tuned. 2026-09-30.

day.title: Day
day.description: Sunlit Swedish pine forest. Warm olive-gold ground, orange pine bark, one cool colour: the sky.

fog.title: Fog
fog.description: The same forest with the other world showing through. One cold blue-slate ramp, near-black shadows, and a few saturated accents that are the only colour left.

ramp.use: Deepest shadow: under boulders, tree hollows, cave mouths. Outlines.
Shadow side of everything. Default dark for UI panels.
Shaded mid-tones: bark in shade, wet ground, dark cloth.
Neutral mid-tone. Undyed wool, weathered wood, plain stone.
Lit surfaces without a strong hue of their own.
Highest highlight. Day: cloud, lichen glare, sun on stone. Fog: the fog ceiling, rime.

environment.use: Needle mass of pine and spruce in shade; distant treeline.
Forest-floor moss, ferns, blueberry leaves. The default green.
Moss where light hits it. Day: the yellow-green that sells sunshine. Fog: dew-grey.
Trunks at eye height; wooden buildings, fences, signposts.
Boulders, runestones, cliff faces, the mountain (berget).
Pale lichen crust on rock. In fog this is rime and frost.
Paths, needle litter, roots, exposed earth.
Clear sky. Day horizon lightens to #B5D2EE. Fog dusk shifts to violet #6F6A85.
Lingonberries. Also blood, madder-dyed cloth, and danger.
Blueberries with their pale bloom; woad-dyed cloth; cold shadow tint.
Ljung in bloom on rock slabs and bog edges.

day.use: Golden sunlight: beams, rim light, hearth glow. Primary highlight for interactables and UI.
Sun disc, lens flare, the hottest point of any light.
Orange upper bark of Scots pine. Warm secondary accent; wood in firelight.

fog.use: Translucent spirit bodies, active runes, the cold light of the fog state. UI highlight in fog.
Wisp cores, spirit eyes, hottest highlight in fog.
Rust-ochre carvings in stone, old iron, dried blood.
Lantern, cairn fire, torch. The only warm light in fog: reserve it for safety and for light the player or the village made.
Peach band at the horizon when the fog rolls in at sunset.

ui.note: ramp.shadow of each state, at about 85% opacity
sun in day, spirit in fog: interact prompts, selected item, quest marker
day lingon in both states so it stays readable; one of two saturation exceptions in fog
day moss-lit in both states; the other saturation exception
